title: Mid-Term Tier Upgrades on Rental Property Service Contracts
content:
**U1. When a tier may be upgraded.** A Rental Property Service Contracts tier may be upgraded mid-term only when the current tier allows a mid-term upgrade and the contract status is waiting period or active. Both are read from the contract's system record before the upgrade. Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus and Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus do not allow one; the other four tiers do.

**U2.** An upgrade moves to a higher-ranked tier whose entry gate the property satisfies; downgrades happen only at renewal. The upgrade takes effect on the request date and keeps the term dates.

**U3.** A monthly-billed contract is billed the new tier's installment from the next billing period.

**U4 (retired) — no longer in force as an unqualified clause:** "An annual-billed contract is billed one upgrade proration charge equal to the difference between the two tiers' annual premiums under the premium billing terms (same portfolio discount) times the unexpired term days divided by the term days, rounded to the cent, both day counts taken as of the upgrade date." The unexpired term days are the calendar days from the day after the upgrade date through the term end date; the term days run from the term start date through the term end date, both included. This clause is superseded by the current basis: for a catch-up charge on an annual-billed contract whose upgrade charge was never billed, the catch-up method replaces this proration, and only for a catch-up charge; for an annual-billed contract moving up to a Plus tier (Bridgewell Rental Combo to Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus, or Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo to Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus) the Plus upgrade charge basis fixes the charge, and only for such a move; every other upgrade of an annual-billed contract is still billed as this clause states.

**U5.** Items and higher caps added by the upgrade are covered only for failures first reported at least the tier's upgrade waiting period (30 calendar days on every tier) after the upgrade, as the coverage determination conditions state.

## U1 at a glance

| Current tier | Status | Mid-term upgrade |
|---|---|---|
| Appliance, Systems, Combo or Multi-Unit Combo | waiting period or active | allowed |
| Appliance, Systems, Combo or Multi-Unit Combo | suspended for nonpayment, expired or cancelled | not allowed |
| Combo Plus or Multi-Unit Combo Plus | any | not allowed |

## Worked figure under U4 (hypothetical annual-billed upgrade outside the superseded cases)

Bridgewell Rental Appliance to Bridgewell Rental Systems, one unit, no portfolio discount, 200 of 365 term days unexpired on the upgrade date. The annual premiums are $464.29 and $518.29, a difference of $54.00; $54.00 times 200 divided by 365 is $29.589, rounded to **$29.59**.

superseded_clauses: an annual-billed contract is billed one upgrade_proration charge equal to the difference between the two tiers' annual premiums under landlord_premium_pricing (same portfolio discount) times landlord_msr_unexpired_term_days divided by landlord_msr_term_days, rounded to the cent, both day counts taken as of the upgrade date.
